effect.rpgworldmod.paralysis.description: Prevents the target from changing items in hands or interacting with anything in inventory. Level 2 of the effect prevents the target from changing the direction of their gaze.
effect.rpgworldmod.mossiosis.description: Covers the target's first few hearts with moss. Instantly kills if only moss-covered hearts remain. The number of moss-covered hearts increases by 3 per effect level.
effect.rpgworldmod.mosquitoing.descripti: The target is covered in mosquitoes and takes damage over time. The interval of damage received is shorter as the effect level increases.
effect.rpgworldmod.fueling.description: The target is covered in oil and its density is lower than that of water. Taking damage sets target on fire.
effect.rpgworldmod.paranoia.description: Disables natural mana regeneration and drains mana.
effect.rpgworldmod.happiness.description: Increases maximum mana and regenerates it.
effect.rpgworldmod.burn_illusion.descrip: The target thinks it's on fire, but it doesn't actually take damage.
effect.rpgworldmod.burnout.description: Target and some of its hearts are ignited. Extinguishing also extinguishes hearts. The next time target receives damage from an entity, all ignited hearts get burnt, turning them into damage to that entity.
effect.rpgworldmod.amphibiosis.descripti: Target breathes water instead of air.

enchantment.rpgworldmod.restoration.desc: One of the six types of magic. Anything related to increasing and restoring characteristics, applying positive effects and protecting against negative effects.
enchantment.rpgworldmod.alteration.desc: One of the six types of magic. Anything related to rearranging and changing any parameters and values, applying negative effects and turning one into another.
enchantment.rpgworldmod.illusion.desc: One of the six types of magic. Anything that can distort someone's perception of reality, influence someone's emotions or actions, and that can be used secretly.
enchantment.rpgworldmod.conjuration.desc: One of the six types of magic. Anything that is capable of creating something material or imaginary, or complementing something that already exists.
enchantment.rpgworldmod.destruction.desc: One of the six types of magic. Anything that is aimed at causing damage to the environment or can be used as a weapon.
enchantment.rpgworldmod.necromancy.desc: One of the six types of magic. Anything that cannot be used at the cost of mana, but can be used at the cost of health.
